learning_outcomes.text: Possess and understand knowledge that provides a basis or opportunity to be original in the development and/or application of ideas, often in a research context.

That students know how to apply the acquired knowledge and their problem-solving capacity in new or little-known environments within broader (or multidisciplinary) contexts related to their area of study.

That students are able to integrate knowledge and face the complexity of formulating judgments based on information that, being incomplete or limited, includes reflections on the social and ethical responsibilities linked to the application of their knowledge and judgments.
That students know how to communicate their conclusions and the knowledge and ultimate reasons that support them to specialized and non-specialized audiences clearly and unambiguously.
That students possess the learning skills that allow them to continue studying in a way that will be largely self-directed or autonomous.
Develop the potential of information and communication technologies in industrial production.
Apply the knowledge obtained in the master's degree to achieve greater efficiency, effectiveness, reliability or safety in an industrial environment.

Apply the most advanced technologies in intelligent computer control, automation, and plant-level communication systems, for flexible manufacturing and industrial inspection systems in complex facilities.
Handle both theoretically and practically the specific equipment for monitoring and control of automatic production systems.

Specify, design, develop, install, commission and maintain the hardware and software computer architecture of an industrial plant, including automation systems based on programmable controllers and industrial inspection systems for quality control, predictive maintenance and improved process knowledge.
Correctly apply the mandatory specifications, regulations and standards in the field of automatic industrial production systems.
Use the acquired knowledge to maintain a critical and active attitude in the management of automation projects.

Apply the competencies acquired in the master's degree in a real work environment, integrated into a work team within a company that carries out its activity in one of the fields related to the master's degree.
Apply the acquired theoretical knowledge, putting it into practice in the development of an external work linked to the exercise of activity in a suitable professional, public or private environment.
Aptitude for working in multidisciplinary teams.

syllabus_topics: Integration of the student into operational work teams
Understanding a work environment external to the academic one
teaching_methods: Work to be developed in the company or entity
Field trips to industrial companies and plants
assessment_rules: The evaluation of Company Internships is carried out according to the evaluation regulations for company internships of the University of Oviedo. This can be found at https://epigijon.uniovi.es/c/document_library/get_file?uuid=a69ef1a7-46db-4d52-810f-34d8d8e305d9&groupId=3743853.
